notes.title: Coming soon Game UPDATE
notes.notes:
COMING SOON! UPDATE Version 1.0

Stay tuned for upcoming updates for the game. Include some new enhanced versions of the game & updated content. The game will have some improvements to the overall gameplay experience.

Thank you for all the feedback.

notes.title: Update 0.1.6
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed some players getting stuck on the Maze gate or the gate not opening.
[*] Fixed player gets stuck under the elevator and pushed outside the level.
[*] Some other minor bugs fixed 
[/list]

I'm still checking for other bugs in the game and improvements. please let me know if there are any bugs while playing the game.

Thank you and enjoy! :)

notes.title: RUSA Odyssey release 28 July!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=LcmKj3YioIQ;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]Hi everyone! after so long, RUSA Odyssey will finally be released on 28! Hopefully, all is good for the release! It has been almost 3 years since I started this project. Thank you for all the support.

Hopefully, you all will enjoy my little game!
